title: Zelda is back and better than ever

claims.claim: Bambu Lab H3C 3D yazıcının fiyatı 2.500 dolardır.

evidence.quote: The Bambu Lab H3C. I am dangerously close to becoming a 3D Printer Dude. At $2,500, this one’s a little steep for my wallet

claims.claim: Tristan Homsi, Readwise'ın kurucu ortaklarından biridir.

evidence.quote: I’ve talked to Tristan Homsi, one of the Readwise cofounders, a few times over the years
The phone: iPhone 13 (!).Believe it or not, I chose to buy this relatively outdated phone last year

The Sony MDR-3R headphones. Respect to Sony for taking the retro headphone trend all the way to its logical conclusion and just releasing the headphones from the original Walkman. You’ll look a little like Nathan Fielder in You Can See Everything when you wear them, and $60 ain’t cheap

claims.claim: Kagi arama motoru, kullanıcılarına ödeme yapmadan önce 50 ücretsiz arama hakkı sunmaktadır.

evidence.quote: I also am a huge fan of the somewhat-defunct social app BeReal. It had its moment in 2022

claims.claim: Tristan Homsi, Readwise Books uygulamasının kurucu ortağı Daniel Doyon ile birlikte çalışmaktadır.

evidence.quote: (I also asked Daniel Doyon, Readwise’s other cofounder, to share, and he didn’t respond. Daniel is dead to me.)

claims.claim: Kagi arama motoru aylık 10 dolar ücretle sunulmaktadır.
